{"summary":"The sandbox reconciliation reproduced the reported delta: gross dashboard savings exceed the report total until the net-of-fee adjustment and the frozen vCPU-based baseline are applied, after which the numbers reconcile."}

The two numbers answer different questions. The dashboard shows gross savings — the difference between the frozen read-only baseline price and the actual compute cost. The monthly report applies the net-of-fee adjustment (a 5% fee rate on positive gross savings) and reports negative days instead of clamping them, so the report total is lower by design. The baseline is a vCPU-based unit price: the ratio of sums of compute cost over provisioned vCPUs across the read-only baseline window, frozen when autoscaling starts. Workload growth is handled by weighting the baseline with the evaluation-window vCPU average, so a growing workload does not erase the savings number.
